Stamp and write flextab objects to one or multiple formats

Source: R/ftstamp.R
ftstamp.Rd

Stamp and write flextab objects to one or multiple formats

Usage

ftstamp(
  ft,
  file,
  script,
  time,
  model,
  stamp.ft.style,
  stamp.format = NULL,
  stamp.funs = NULL
)

Arguments

ft

a flextable object

file

The file that the flextable will be written to (no file is written by this function)

script

path to script - will be pasted as caption.

time

The default is to insert a time stamp taken from result of Sys.time(). Using the time argument you can overrule this by setting a fixed string instead. Use "" to omit.

model

Character string or model object specifying the model name/identifier. Used for stamping. If a list (model object) is provided, the $label element is extracted.

stamp.ft.style

A list specifying formatting options for the stamp. Valid elements include: size (font size, default 4), align (text alignment, default "right"), space (line spacing, default 1), bg (background color, default "#ffffff"), and color (text color, default "#666666"). Any unspecified elements use the defaults.

stamp.format

A template for the stamp text using the placeholders %script, %time, %model, and %file, with "\n" for line breaks. Default is "%file\n%script\n%model\n%time". See createStamp.

stamp.funs

Optional named list of functions (elements script, time, model, file) used to preprocess the values before they are inserted into stamp.format. See createStamp.

Value

A flextable object with the stamp added as a footer line.
